cases.question: Could the kidnapper be the father's brother in the fixed story?
Is the person holding him captive also his sole surviving family member?
Is the demand for money real even though the eventual outcome is unknown?
Does the kidnapper explicitly require the daughter to arrive unaccompanied?
Does the story establish that she eventually arrives and is murdered?
Does the father object because he believes an explosive will detonate?
Does the father expect the criminal to spare him once paid?
Is the father willing to put himself at risk to keep his daughter away?
